_comment: MIRROR, not original. The manifest contract is declared by Core in
system/contracts/manifest-contract.yaml and enforced by Core itself.
v11 makes two changes to the approved unit material dossier. Every
deep-reviewed route assessment now carries scope_of_absence: the exact
pages that review had in front of it, in house style. Every negative
claim in contribution or limitations is bounded by it and by nothing
wider, and Core checks it against the inspected slices exactly like
The freshness reasons enum also drops unit_revision. Publishing a
dossier guards the unit artifact, so the commit bumped the unit's
revision after the basis had already been derived: every dossier was
born one revision behind and reported a stale basis from the moment it
was written. The revision is still recorded as provenance; it is no
longer compared, and so can no longer be a reason.
